summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry for ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, which buffers the control only when is_terminal is true and returns True or False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy dispatch branch that calls term.set_title with the title. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: per instructions I did not run tests or Black, so all changes are verified by reading only. Nothing is committed.
